evidence: Touches transaction orphan handling and 1P1C package relay logic in net_processing, carrying the P2P label.
rationale: Fixes an invalid debug assertion crash and improper state handling in orphan processing when a child transaction enters the mempool via RPC. According to the PR description, 'Find1P1CPackage can pick it as the child of a reconsiderable parent, and package evaluation then reports it as MEMPOOL_ENTRY, which hit Assume(false)'. Resolving this edge case ensures proper package relay handling without hitting false assertion failures.
